core.description: Capabilities expected in every standard EA portal.

specialized.description: Vertical-specific capabilities assembled only when the client recipe requires them.

openSourceAcceptanceGate.policy: No component may become an EA chassis dependency when required production functionality forces a paid subscription, paid account, per-client license, per-user license, or mandatory usage fee.

pretix.reason: Self-hosted core is available, but AGPL plus additional terms require explicit review for EA-managed third-party/client event use before expanding dependency.

documenso.reason: Community Edition is self-hostable and API-only SaaS use can fit Community terms, but proprietary source modifications or enterprise-only features can require commercial licensing. Keep behind an API boundary and do not fork into EA proprietary code.

novu.reason: MIT open core exists for community self-hosting, but some capabilities are commercial/cloud-only. Approve only after the exact EA notification feature set is mapped to community functionality.

unleash.reason: Self-hosting is available, but current source licensing changed to AGPLv3 while official open-source Docker images retain Apache terms. Do not embed or modify until the deployment boundary is fixed.

formbricks.reason: Not selected for embedded EA Forms capability because the previously reviewed white-label/editor terms conflict with the desired reusable EA product model.
